purpose: Deterministic proposal-to-archive substrate for later mixed and photonic DiHiggs LLP benchmark-family search.

scope.diagnostic_envelope_status: BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION: existing evidence does not justify an envelope containing the required 500-1000 mm anchor interval

continuation.name: Q_S
continuation.family_rule: derive each validation mass with the anchor Q and S, retaining tan_beta and lambda6 (therefore X)

gates.theory: positivity_reported_ok == 1 and unitarity_ok == 1 and perturbativity_ok == 1 and theory_ok_v1 == 1
gates.width: width_ok == 1 and total_width_GeV is finite and positive
gates.lifetime: ctau_mm is finite and abs(ctau_mm - hbar_c_GeV_mm/total_width_GeV) <= 1e-10 * max(1, abs(ctau_mm))

evidence_labels_only.mixed_like: x approximately 1500 in the post-fix descriptive campaign
evidence_labels_only.photonic_like: x approximately 10000 in the post-fix descriptive campaign

classification.promotion_requires: explicit numerical predicates and active-125.20 fixtures supplied by a scientific owner

score.note: These are engineering ranking semantics, not experimental efficiency or recast quantities. Hard invalidity is never compensated.

archive.near_duplicate_metric: RMS normalized Euclidean distance over the five canonical proposal coordinates across the three family masses
archive.tie_break: higher score, then lexicographically smaller family_id
archive.rejected_and_evicted: retain in append-only ledger; never delete

scientific_blockers: BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION: no authoritative numerical mixed/photonic classifier thresholds
BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION: no active-125.20 golden fixtures for those thresholds
BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION: no justified diagnostic lifetime envelope
